pages.name: What Glints in the Water
pages.description: A smooth piece of amber with a dark twig inside lies on the bottom. A copper valve glints in one wall of the pond.

options.description: Try to reach the amber by hand

pages.name: Water for the Roses
pages.description: The water level falls rapidly. An amber paperweight remains on the exposed bottom. You take it and turn the valve again. The pond fills with water.

scenePatch.description: The round pond is full of water again. The roses drop their petals into it.

pages.name: Deceptive Depth
pages.description: The bottom seems close, but your arm sinks into the water almost to your shoulder. Your fingers only brush the smooth amber, and it slips deeper between the stones.
